name: GitHub Copilot
description: Installs the GitHub Copilot CLI and configures GitHub Copilot VS Code extensions.

rulefilePath.description: Path to the central rules file, relative to the workspace root. Default is empty (disabled). Set to a path (e.g. 'docs/agents/AGENTS.md') to enable rules symlinking.

skillsPath.description: Path to the modular skills directory, relative to the workspace root. Default is empty (disabled). Set to a path (e.g. 'docs/agents/skills') to enable skills mapping.
